# KR-2 engine vs synthetic dataset - consistency check (NOT accuracy)

Records: Confirmed fault records and 'No Fault Detected' records from `data_preparation/data/interim/cleaned_pump_dataset.csv`.

**Read this correctly:** the dataset and its labels were generated by this project from its own assumptions, using different symptom thresholds from the knowledge base and recording operator observations only ~85% of the time. Agreement or disagreement here shows how the engine behaves on realistic-looking inputs; it is **not** evidence of diagnostic accuracy on real pumps.

Inputs: sensor columns become measurements (imputed values marked unknown); operator-recorded observed/trend symptoms become 'present'; observations not recorded stay 'unknown'; all pumps are assumed radial; no diagnostic test results are supplied (so nothing can be 'confirmed').

Typical reasons for low agreement (by design, not bugs):
- No test results are available, so test-based rules (R-CAV-2, R-MIS-1, cause rules) cannot fire.
- Many rules need operator observations that the synthetic records often omit; missing observations stay unknown, so rules remain pending instead of guessing.
- The engine's provisional thresholds (e.g. vibration >= 6.0 mm/s) differ from the generator's.
- Misalignment's only Strong-sourced route is the alignment test; its symptom rule is unvalidated.
